0001: #===============================================================================
0002: # Given an array of trainers and the number of wins the player already has,
0003: # returns a random trainer index. The more wins, the later in the list the
0004: # trainer comes from.
0005: #===============================================================================
0006: def pbBattleChallengeTrainer(win_count, bttrainers)
0007:   # This table's start points and lengths are based on a bttrainers size of 300.
0008:   # They are scaled based on the actual size of bttrainers later.
0009:   table = [   # Each value is [minimum win count, range start point, range length]
0010:     [ 0,   0, 100],   # 0-100
0011:     [ 6,  80,  40],   # 80-120
0012:     [ 7,  80,  40],   # 80-120
0013:     [13, 120,  20],   # 120-140
0014:     [14, 100,  40],   # 100-140
0015:     [20, 140,  20],   # 140-160
0016:     [21, 120,  40],   # 120-160
0017:     [27, 160,  20],   # 160-180
0018:     [28, 140,  40],   # 140-180
0019:     [34, 180,  20],   # 180-200
0020:     [35, 160,  40],   # 160-200
0021:     [41, 200,  20],   # 200-220
0022:     [42, 180,  40],   # 180-220
0023:     [48, 220,  40],   # 220-260
0024:     [49, 200, 100]    # 200-300 - This line is used for all higher win_counts
0025:   ]
0026:   slot = nil
0027:   table.each { |val| slot = val if val[0] <= win_count && (!slot || slot[0] < val[0]) }
0028:   return 0 if !slot
0029:   # Scale the start point and length based on how many trainers are in bttrainers
0030:   offset = slot[1] * bttrainers.length / 300
0031:   length = slot[2] * bttrainers.length / 300
0032:   # Return a random trainer index from the chosen range
0033:   return offset + rand(length)
0034: end

0039: def pbGenerateBattleTrainer(idxTrainer, rules)
0040:   bttrainers = pbGetBTTrainers(pbBattleChallenge.currentChallenge)
0041:   btpokemon = pbGetBTPokemon(pbBattleChallenge.currentChallenge)
0042:   level = rules.ruleset.suggestedLevel
0043:   # Create the trainer
0044:   trainerdata = bttrainers[idxTrainer]
0045:   opponent = NPCTrainer.new(
0046:     pbGetMessageFromHash(MessageTypes::TRAINER_NAMES, trainerdata[1]),
0047:     trainerdata[0]
0048:   )
0049:   # Determine how many IVs the trainer's Pokémon will have
0050:   indvalues = 31
0051:   indvalues = 21 if idxTrainer < 220
0052:   indvalues = 18 if idxTrainer < 200
0053:   indvalues = 15 if idxTrainer < 180
0054:   indvalues = 12 if idxTrainer < 160
0055:   indvalues = 9 if idxTrainer < 140
0056:   indvalues = 6 if idxTrainer < 120
0057:   indvalues = 3 if idxTrainer < 100
0058:   # Get the indices within bypokemon of the Pokémon the trainer may have
0059:   pokemonnumbers = trainerdata[5]
0060:   # The number of possible Pokémon is <= the required number; make them
0061:   # all Pokémon and use them
0062:   if pokemonnumbers.length <= rules.ruleset.suggestedNumber
0063:     pokemonnumbers.each do |n|
0064:       rndpoke = btpokemon[n]
0065:       pkmn = rndpoke.createPokemon(level, indvalues, opponent)
0066:       opponent.party.push(pkmn)
0067:     end
0068:     return opponent
0069:   end
0070:   # There are more possible Pokémon than there are spaces available in the
0071:   # trainer's party; randomly choose Pokémon
0072:   loop do
0073:     opponent.party.clear
0074:     while opponent.party.length < rules.ruleset.suggestedNumber
0075:       rnd = pokemonnumbers[rand(pokemonnumbers.length)]
0076:       rndpoke = btpokemon[rnd]
0077:       pkmn = rndpoke.createPokemon(level, indvalues, opponent)
0078:       opponent.party.push(pkmn)
0079:     end
0080:     break if rules.ruleset.isValid?(opponent.party)
0081:   end
0082:   return opponent
0083: end

0085: #===============================================================================
0086: # Generate a full team's worth of Pokémon which obey the given rules.
0087: #===============================================================================
0088: def pbBattleFactoryPokemon(rules, win_count, swap_count, rentals)
0089:   btpokemon = pbGetBTPokemon(pbBattleChallenge.currentChallenge)
0090:   level = rules.ruleset.suggestedLevel
0091:   pokemonNumbers = [0, 0]   # Start and end indices in btpokemon
0092:   ivs = [0, 0]   # Lower and higher IV values for Pokémon to use
0093:   iv_threshold = 6   # Number of Pokémon that use the lower IV
0094:   set = [win_count / 7, 7].min   # The set of 7 battles win_count is part of (minus 1)
0095:   # Choose a range of Pokémon in btpokemon to randomly select from. The higher
0096:   # the set number, the later the range lies within btpokemon (typically).
0097:   # This table's start point and end point values are based on a btpokemon size
0098:   # of 881. They are scaled based on the actual size of btpokemon.
0099:   # Group 1 is 0 - 173. Group 2 is 174 - 371. Group 3 is 372 - 881.
0100:   if level == GameData::GrowthRate.max_level   # Open Level (Level 100)
0101:     table = [
0102:       [372, 491],   # Group 3 (first quarter)
0103:       [492, 610],   # Group 3 (second quarter)
0104:       [611, 729],   # Group 3 (third quarter)
0105:       [730, 849],   # Group 3 (fourth quarter)
0106:       [372, 881],   # All of Group 3
0107:       [372, 881],   # All of Group 3
0108:       [372, 881],   # All of Group 3
0109:       [372, 881]    # This line is used for all higher sets (all of Group 3)
0110:     ]
0111:   else
0112:     table = [
0113:       [  0, 173],   # Group 1
0114:       [174, 272],   # Group 2 (first half)
0115:       [273, 371],   # Group 2 (second half)
0116:       [372, 491],   # Group 3 (first quarter)
0117:       [492, 610],   # Group 3 (second quarter)
0118:       [611, 729],   # Group 3 (third quarter)
0119:       [730, 849],   # Group 3 (fourth quarter)
0120:       [372, 881]    # This line is used for all higher sets (all of Group 3)
0121:     ]
0122:   end
0123:   pokemonNumbers[0] = table[set][0] * btpokemon.length / 881
0124:   pokemonNumbers[1] = table[set][1] * btpokemon.length / 881
0125:   # Choose two IV values for Pokémon to use (the one for the current set, and
0126:   # the one for the next set). The iv_threshold below determines which of these
0127:   # two values a given Pokémon uses. The higher the set number, the higher these
0128:   # values are.
0129:   ivtable = [3, 6, 9, 12, 15, 21, 31, 31]   # Last value is used for all higher sets
0130:   ivs = [ivtable[set], ivtable[[set + 1, 7].min]]
0131:   # Choose a threshold, which is the number of Pokémon with the lower IV out of
0132:   # the two chosen above. The higher the swap_count, the lower this threshold
0133:   # (i.e. the more Pokémon will have the higher IV).
0134:   thresholds = [   # Each value is [minimum swap count, threshold value]
0135:     [ 0, 6],
0136:     [15, 5],
0137:     [22, 4],
0138:     [29, 3],
0139:     [36, 2],
0140:     [43, 1]
0141:   ]
0142:   thresholds.each { |val| iv_threshold = val[1] if swap_count >= val[0] }
0143:   # Randomly choose Pokémon from the range to fill the party with
0144:   old_min = rules.ruleset.minLength
0145:   old_max = rules.ruleset.maxLength
0146:   if rentals.length == 0
0147:     rules.ruleset.setNumber(6)   # Rentals
0148:   else
0149:     rules.ruleset.setNumber(old_max + rentals.length)   # Opponent
0150:   end
0151:   party = []
0152:   loop do
0153:     party.clear
0154:     while party.length < ((rentals.length == 0) ? 6 : old_max)
0155:       rnd = pokemonNumbers[0] + rand(pokemonNumbers[1] - pokemonNumbers[0] + 1)
0156:       rndpoke = btpokemon[rnd]
0157:       indvalue = (party.length < iv_threshold) ? ivs[0] : ivs[1]
0158:       party.push(rndpoke.createPokemon(level, indvalue, nil))
0159:     end
0160:     break if rules.ruleset.isValid?([].concat(party).concat(rentals))
0161:   end
0162:   rules.ruleset.setNumberRange(old_min, old_max)
0163:   return party
0164: end
